# The Splendid Table

> A public radio culinary program hosted by Francis Lam featuring recipes, episodes, and food journalism from American Public Media.

The Splendid Table is a long-running public radio show and podcast that explores food culture through interviews with chefs, seasonal recipes, and cooking education. The program is produced by American Public Media and offers content through multiple platforms including radio broadcasts, podcasts, and an extensive recipe collection.

## Key Topics

- Francis Lam
- American Public Media
- Seasonal cooking
- Recipe collection
- Weeknight meals
- Food interviews
- Podcast episodes
- Food journalism
- Food culture
- Ingredient-focused cooking
- Halloumi
- Tamarind
- Meyer Lemon
- Home cooking
- Cooking education

## Core Content

- [The Splendid Table](https://www.splendidtable.org): Homepage for The Splendid Table public radio culinary program hosted by Francis Lam
- [All Recipes](https://www.splendidtable.org/recipes): Recipe collection featuring seasonal ingredients like carrots, halloumi, and tamarind
- [Episodes](https://www.splendidtable.org/episodes): Podcast episode archive with interviews featuring chefs Eric Adjepong and Ozoz Sokoh
- [About the Splendid Table](https://www.splendidtable.org/about-splendid-table): Program history and host information for Francis Lam and American Public Media
